notes: The chart gets its Groww chrome. Top bar is now the reference bar: back, the interval as text, chart-type, fx, draw, rotate, and a kebab menu - the symbol name lives in the chart legend where TradingView prints it. Below the chart, the Groww info row: Date Range, the live clock with the candle countdown, and auto-fit. Position lines speak the reference grammar now: blue entry, green target, orange stop.
